dedupe_keys.name: cuzk inspire transport networks rail road air water and cable czech republic

description: The Czech Office for Surveying, Mapping and Cadastre (ČÚZK) publishes five INSPIRE Transport Networks datasets for the Czech Republic: Rail (TN_RAIL), Road (TN_ROAD), Air (TN_AIR), Water (TN_WATER) and Cable (TN_CABLE). They are derived from the Fundamental Base of Geographic Data of the Czech Republic (ZABAGED), harmonised according to the INSPIRE implementing rules and conform to INSPIRE XML schema version 4.0, so they share a structure with the same theme across Europe; objects are vector features with attributes. Coverage is national. The data are free under the Creative Commons CC BY 4.0 licence and available to download as GeoPackage files for the whole country (the road dataset is about 713 MB and the rail dataset about 19 MB) in ETRS89 / UTM zone 33N, and through WMS, WFS and Atom download services and a web map viewer. The derived INSPIRE datasets are republished quarterly; the rail product was last updated in April 2026. Caveats: as INSPIRE derivatives they carry the INSPIRE attribute set, not all ZABAGED attributes, and the national topographic database itself covers all themes. The harmonised networks support multimodal network flow and hazard exposure analysis of Czech transport and cross-border comparison with other INSPIRE datasets. They are related to the Czech railway corridor mobile coverage measurements and complement OpenStreetMap.
